summary: Cronos Group Inc. filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing a Second Amendment to its December 9, 2025 Share Sale and Purchase Agreement. Purchaser CGM B.V. and Cronos as Guarantor agreed with Sellers Ring International Holding AG and Landewyck Tobacco S.A. to acquire all shares of CanAdelaar B.V., a licensed Dutch cannabis grower. The amendment extends the Long Stop Date from September 9, 2026, to October 15, 2026. No price, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. The transaction remains subject to closing; watch for further extensions or completion risk.
